nodes.name: APAFAPIGateway
nodes.description: Entry point for all external client requests, routing them to appropriate microservices. Handles cross-cutting concerns like authentication, authorization, and rate limiting.
responsibilities: Route incoming requests to backend services
Enforce authentication and authorization policies
Provide a unified API for web clients and external consumers

nodes.name: APAFWebApp
nodes.description: The client-side web application providing user interfaces for public data displays and password-protected science analysis displays.
responsibilities: Render web-based displays of current ASPERA-3 data for public view
Render web-based displays for science analysis for ASPERA-3 team members
Handle user login and session management for protected views

nodes.name: AuthNAuthZService
nodes.description: Manages user authentication and authorization for access to protected APAF resources and web displays.
responsibilities: Manage user accounts and roles
Authenticate users (e.g., ASPERA-3 team members)
Authorize access to specific data and functionalities

nodes.name: AuthNAuthZDB
nodes.description: Dedicated database for storing user credentials, roles, and authorization policies for the AuthNAuthZService.
responsibilities: Persist user authentication and authorization data

nodes.name: TelemetryAcquisitionService
nodes.description: Responsible for acquiring raw ASPERA-3 and Mars Express Orbit/Attitude (MEX OA) telemetry data from ESOC.
responsibilities: Connect to ESOC systems
Retrieve ASPERA-3 telemetry data
Retrieve MEX OA telemetry data
Store raw telemetry for initial processing

nodes.name: RawTelemetryDB
nodes.description: Dedicated database for storing raw, unprocessed ASPERA-3 and MEX OA telemetry data acquired from ESOC.
responsibilities: Persist raw telemetry data

nodes.name: ProcessingOrchestratorService
nodes.description: Orchestrates the complex daily data processing and archiving workflow using the Saga pattern, coordinating multiple services.
responsibilities: Initiate and manage the daily data processing saga
Coordinate telemetry cleaning, IDFS processing, archiving, calibration, and dissemination steps
Handle saga state and compensation logic for failures

nodes.name: SagaStateDB
nodes.description: Dedicated database for the ProcessingOrchestratorService to store the current state of ongoing sagas and transaction logs.
responsibilities: Persist saga state and history

nodes.name: TelemetryCleaningService
nodes.description: Cleans raw ASPERA-3 and MEX OA telemetry data and generates intermediate cleaned-up telemetry files.
responsibilities: Perform data cleaning on raw telemetry
Generate intermediate files of cleaned-up telemetry
Store cleaned telemetry and intermediate files

nodes.name: CleanedTelemetryDB
nodes.description: Dedicated database for storing cleaned ASPERA-3 and MEX OA telemetry data and any generated intermediate files.
responsibilities: Persist cleaned telemetry and intermediate files

nodes.name: IDFSProcessingService
nodes.description: Processes cleaned telemetry and ancillary data into Instrument Data File Set (IDFS) data sets.
responsibilities: Process ASPERA-3 science data into IDFS format
Process engineering and ancillary information into IDFS format
Store generated IDFS data sets

nodes.name: IDFSDataDB
nodes.description: Dedicated database for storing processed ASPERA-3 and MEX OA IDFS data sets.
responsibilities: Persist IDFS data sets

nodes.name: CalibrationValidationService
nodes.description: Performs calibration and validation of ASPERA-3 data prior to its deposition in NASA PDS.
responsibilities: Execute calibration algorithms on ASPERA-3 data
Perform validation checks on ASPERA-3 data integrity and quality
Store calibration and validation results

nodes.name: CalibrationValidationDB
nodes.description: Dedicated database for storing calibration parameters, validation rules, and results for the CalibrationValidationService.
responsibilities: Persist calibration and validation data

nodes.name: SwRILocalArchiveService
nodes.description: Manages the storage and retrieval of all APAF-generated data (raw, cleaned, IDFS) to the physical SwRI Local Archive.
responsibilities: Store raw telemetry data in SwRI Local Archive
Store cleaned telemetry and intermediate files in SwRI Local Archive
Store IDFS data sets in SwRI Local Archive
Provide mechanisms for data retrieval and re-processing

nodes.name: ArchiveMetadataDB
nodes.description: Dedicated database for the SwRILocalArchiveService to store metadata and indexing information about archived files.
responsibilities: Persist metadata for archived data

nodes.name: PublicDataDisplayService
nodes.description: Provides an API for the APAFWebApp to display the most current ASPERA-3 data for public viewing.
responsibilities: Retrieve and format current ASPERA-3 data for public display
Serve data to the public web interface

nodes.name: PublicDisplayCacheDB
nodes.description: Dedicated database for the PublicDataDisplayService to store frequently accessed or pre-rendered public display data for performance.
responsibilities: Cache public display data

nodes.name: ScienceDataAccessService
nodes.description: Provides an API for the ASPERA-3 team to access any available ASPERA-3 data for science analysis.
responsibilities: Provide secure access to all available ASPERA-3 data for authorized users
Support data querying and retrieval for science analysis

edges.payload_description: Authentication tokens, authorization requests for protected resources
edges.justification: The API Gateway enforces authentication and authorization policies by consulting the AuthNAuthZService for incoming requests to protected resources.
AuthNAuthZService persists data to dedicated datastore AuthNAuthZDB
APAFWebApp persists data to dedicated datastore RawTelemetryDB
APAFWebApp persists data to dedicated datastore SagaStateDB
APAFWebApp persists data to dedicated datastore CleanedTelemetryDB
APAFWebApp persists data to dedicated datastore IDFSDataDB
CalibrationValidationService persists data to dedicated datastore CalibrationValidationDB
APAFWebApp persists data to dedicated datastore ArchiveMetadataDB
APAFWebApp persists data to dedicated datastore PublicDisplayCacheDB
